quick_skim.title: Extending Dynamic World Surface Water Mapping to Sentinel-1 with AlphaEarth Embeddings
quick_skim.abstract: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google's AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The paper extends Dynamic World land cover water mapping to Sentinel-1 SAR using weak supervision and AlphaEarth embeddings, enabling water maps for every acquisition including cloudy scenes.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: Dynamic World可基于Sentinel-2在10米分辨率全球制图土地利用与土地覆盖，但仅限无云观测，限制了地表水制图的范围与时机。本文以DW水体类别作为弱监督训练Sentinel-1合成孔径雷达模型，并用AlphaEarth嵌入提供空间上下文。在53个全球场景上，仅用S1的模型水体IoU达0.77，接近DW的0.75。该工作拓展了全天候土地覆盖制图与变化监测的能力。
